name: How long does a typical bathroom electrical and lighting upgrade take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom electrical and lighting upgrade take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom electrical and lighting upgrade depends on the complexity of the project. A simple swap of light fixtures and outlets might be completed in a single day. More extensive work, such as adding new circuits, relocating switches, or installing recessed lighting, could take several days. If the project involves opening walls or integrating with a larger bathroom remodel, it will extend the timeline. We will provide an estimated timeframe after assessing your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies; simple upgrades may take a day, while extensive work involving new circuits or wall modifications can take several days.
